message.content: Generating from model parameters alone involves training a model to generate text based solely on the input text. This approach is effective when the model has access to a large amount of training data and can be fine-tuned on specific tasks. However, it may not be suitable for generating text that requires context or is not explicitly labeled. On the other hand, generating with retrieved passages involves training a model to generate text based on the context provided by the retrieved passages. This approach is more suitable for generating text that requires context and is not explicitly labeled.
